en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘The one in whose heart was a mustard seed of prejudice in his heart, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> would Resurrect him on the Day of Judgment along with the Bedouins of the pre-Islamic period’.
en.sarwar: 3. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from al-Nawfali from al-Sakuni from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “

The Messenger of Allah has said, ‘Whoever has racist feelings in his heart of the size of mustard seed, on the Day of Judgment Allah will raise him with the Arabs of the time of Jahiliyah (dark age).’”
